summary: Iter 12 full backend + frontend verification. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed covering (a) geocode endpoint (valid address returns lat/lng, empty=400, employee can call), (b) office create with address-only auto-geocode + name-only=400 + explicit coords still work, (c) POST /api/shifts/bulk create + overlap-skip + empty user_ids=400 + empty days_of_week=400 + employee 403, (d) reports summary/attendance/payroll/overtime for admin (200) and employee (403). Frontend: Reports page renders with 4 stat cards; attendance/payroll/overtime tabs and CSV buttons visible. Shifts page 'Bulk Assign' opens dialog with all 12 required data-testids (search, select-visible, clear, title, location, start, end, from, to, day-1..7, submit). Settings > Offices > Add Office dialog shows Find button + address input. No console errors on the tested flows (only a benign background 401 unrelated to tested endpoints).
critical_code_review_comments: shifts.py bulk overlap query does not use string date comparison guards — works only because effective_from/effective_to are ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings (lexicographic order == chronological). Acceptable but worth a comment.

OfficeLocationsTab: address is sent as `null` when empty; backend model accepts Optional[str] so OK. However `hasLatLng` check treats latitude='0' as falsy — edge case for equator/prime-meridian offices. Low priority.
Nominatim call has no rate-limit protection on server side; add small caching/dedup if this endpoint becomes hot.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_Off_* offices and TEST_Bulk shifts with effective_from=2030-01-01 (future dates) — auto-cleaned via test_cleanup and test_cleanup_shifts fixtures. A pre-existing 'Test Office Address Only' (Banani) row is visible in Settings from an earlier manual iteration; not created by this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests must be run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env set (pytest reads it). Auth uses httpOnly cookies AND does NOT return access_token in JSON body — requests.Session persists the cookie automatically, so no Authorization header needed. Employee-list endpoint is /api/employees (not /api/users or /api/admin/employees). /api/shifts/bulk works and correctly skips overlaps. Reports endpoints return 200 for admin and 403 for employee as expected.
rca of the issue: N/A — both bug fixes and the new feature verified end-to-end.
